panels.general_description: Line and marker chart of calcium, creatinine and intact PTH over time with a VATS arrow.
panels.detailed_description: A chart inside a thin gray frame with the panel letter (b) at upper left. A blue line (legend Ca) and an orange line (legend Cre) are plotted against the left axis labelled Ca (mmol/L) or Cre (mg/dL) with ticks from 1 to 3.5 and 4 in steps of 0.5; intact PTH is shown as four separate green square markers (legend iPTH, no connecting line) against a right axis labelled iPTH (pg/mL) with ticks 0 to 600. The x axis has rotated month-year tick labels. A large black label VATS sits above a red downward arrow. The blue Ca line varies early on, rises toward the VATS arrow and then falls steeply after it before flattening; the orange Cre line fluctuates early and then falls and partly rises again. The green iPTH markers occur both before and after the VATS arrow. A legend at right lists Ca, Cre and iPTH.

panels.detailed_description: Black-background panel with column headings At diagnosis (left pair) and After imatinib (right pair) and large printed letters A, B, C and D. A (coronal, upper left) shows the abdomen with liver, bowel gas and a large rounded gray soft-tissue mass in the lower abdomen and pelvis marked by a yellow arrow from the left. B (axial, lower left) shows the pelvis with a large rounded gray mass occupying the anterior pelvis, with a yellow arrow at its left edge. C (coronal, upper right) is a similar coronal slice in which the region at the yellow arrow is less sharply outlined and looks smaller. D (axial, lower right) shows the pelvis with a yellow arrow at the edge of a smaller, less distinct soft-tissue area. Small orange orientation letters appear at the top and bottom of the coronal images, a tick ruler runs along the bottom of the coronal images, and a curved line (couch edge) lies under the axial image D. No patient names or dates are visible.

panels.general_description: Line chart of calcium, creatinine and intact PTH with treatment annotations for hydration, furosemide, calcitonin, denosumab, imatinib and calcium tablets.
panels.detailed_description: A chart with the panel letter (b) at upper left. Left axis labelled Ca (mmol/L) or Cre (mg/dL) with ticks 1 to 4 in steps of 0.5; right axis labelled iPTH (pg/mL) with ticks 0 to 600 in steps of 100; rotated month-year labels on the x axis; a legend at right lists Ca (blue), Cre (orange) and iPTH (green), all drawn as connected lines. Above the plot are the stacked words Hydration, Furosemide, Calcitonin over a red downward arrow, the word Denosumab over a second red downward arrow, a solid red bar labelled Imatinib extending across the right part, and a small outlined box labelled Ca. tab beneath it. The blue Ca line rises toward the first arrow, drops sharply, rises again up to the denosumab arrow and then declines before rising slightly and easing down at the right end. The green iPTH line stays low and flat, then rises steeply after the denosumab arrow, peaks and eases downward. The orange Cre line rises gradually at first, drops after the first arrow, fluctuates and then rises toward the right end.
